answer.text: Shares offered to existing shareholders in proportion to existing holdings

explanation.text: The Logic: A rights issue is an offer of shares to existing shareholders in proportion to their existing holdings. Shareholders may subscribe partly or fully to their entitlement. The Trap: Free shares to all shareholders describes a bonus issue, not a rights issue. Debt instruments and convertible bonds are separate funding routes. Note: Do not state that rights shares are offered at a discount unless that is separately sourced; the load-bearing point is the proportionate offer to existing shareholders.
